verdict.rationale: Stripe Tax runs headlessly through its APIs. The standalone Tax Calculations and Tax Transactions APIs calculate tax, record transactions and handle reversals, and registrations can be managed through the Tax Registrations API, all without the Dashboard. A sandbox environment for previewing tax behavior and an official Stripe CLI support scripted, non-interactive automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guidance (e.g. headless auth, test pipelines), evidence that the CLI exposes Tax operations specifically, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless or CI use.
